title: The Grunion Run, 2016 · before
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: The day before the pup's first run: the beach by day, Wood walking him along the tide line to show him where, the pup uninterested in the where and interested in a crab. Gully's daughter, six, explaining fish to him. He listens to her.

panels.composition: The beach by day, low tide. WOOD walking the PUP along the tide line. The six-year-old ahead.

panels.composition: The girl crouched to the pup, explaining, hands wide.

balloons.text: The fish come UP. Onto the sand. You have to wait.
